description: Presidential Secretariat - Notify the appointment of Mr. U. R. Seneviratne as the Secretary to the President w.e.f. 06.07.2018
categorisation: The gazette content announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. Udaya Ranjith Seneviratne) to a government position (Secretary to the President). It names the person and provides the basic title of the appointment but does not include any detailed description of the portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
